record.question: In a school, 60% students play cricket. A student who does not play cricket, plays football. Every football player has got a two-wheeler. Which of the following conclusions cannot be drawn from the above data? i. 60% of the students do not have two-wheelers. ii. No cricketer has a two-wheeler. iii. Cricket players do not play football.
record.explanation: The premises require non-cricketers to be football players and football players to own two-wheelers. They do not restrict cricketers from either football or two-wheelers. Thus none of i,ii,iii follows; all three are conclusions that cannot be drawn. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
